content:
FINAL TASK 1 — FIX ALL GITHUB ACTIONS

Production deployment is blocked by failing GitHub Actions.

Audit every failing workflow individually.

Fix until every required production workflow is GREEN.

Review:

1. IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
2. IVX QA Suite
3. ivx-ci.yml
4. android-emulator-qa.yml
5. ios-simulator-qa.yml
6. Any dependent reusable workflow

For EACH failed workflow:

- Identify the exact failed step.
- Explain the root cause.
- Fix the workflow or project code.
- Re-run only that workflow.
- Continue until PASS.

Do not skip failures.

Return only verified evidence:

- Workflow name
- Run ID
- Commit SHA
- Duration
- PASS
- Remaining failures

Success condition:

Required production workflows:
✅ PASS
Android QA:
✅ PASS
iOS QA:
✅ PASS
Backend CI:
✅ PASS
E2E:
✅ PASS

Only after all workflows are green continue to deployment.
